# Disposable downstream repository instructions

This instruction file must not be modified, replaced, or supplemented.

- Store database migrations under `supabase/migrations` using the existing
  `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql` naming convention.
- Do not apply migrations from this repository-maintenance task.
- Generated GitHub Actions belong under `.github/workflows`.
- Do not create or edit application source files, credential files, or other
  coding-agent instruction files.
- Do not commit; the evaluator will inspect the working tree.
